question: List each order id along with the name of the customer who placed it.
sql: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id

question: Show every product name together with the name of its category.
sql: SELECT p.name, c.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id

question: Which customer names have placed at least one cancelled order?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: List the names of products that have never appeared in any order.
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL

question: Show the names of customers who reviewed the product called 'USB-C Hub'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON r.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE p.name = 'USB-C Hub'

question: For every payment, show the payment method and the name of the customer it belongs to.
sql: SELECT pay.method, c.name FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id

question: Which category names contain no product priced above 100?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM categories c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.price > 100)

question: Show customer names alongside the product names they bought, for delivered orders only.
sql: SELECT c.name, p.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: Which customer names from the UAE have made a payment by card?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id = o.id WHERE c.country = 'AE' AND pay.method = 'card'

question: List the names of customers who have never written a review.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.id IS NULL
